title: Settlement sizes for cities and towns
summary: DMs can give each city or town a size, from Thorp to Metropolis, and new shops there start with the wealth that size suggests.
items: Choose a size for a city or town in Market under Manage regions, cities, towns and areas. Its areas share it.
Pick Pathfinder's eight sizes (the default) or five simple steps, and rename any size.
A size suggests the wealth of new shops there: hamlets start Poor, small towns Modest, large towns Rich and large cities Princely.
Optionally give new shops in a place a merchant purse and a refill amount.
Shops that already exist keep their wealth and purse; a size only sets the starting values of new shops.
Players see a place's size and population where they can already see the place, never your new-shop settings.
